ORCHESTRATOR-CONFIRMED (Step 5b) metadata defect. The agent's Step 3b finding is correct: metadata/biblio.csv line 6454 describes frikha_2023_pe_acrs as 'Perceived E-learning Acceptance and Course Rating Scale (PE-ACRS)'. That 4/4/4 allocation is corroborated independently of the wording by the source workbook's own stored subscale sums, which verify_batch.R reproduced at 308/308 (Autonomy, Relatedness) and 306/308 (Competence) rows. The Harvard Dataverse deposit title likewise reads 'gender differences in motivation PNS and academic achievement'. The biblio Description should be corrected to the PE autonomy relatedness competence scale (PE-ARCS) of Sulz, Temple & Gibbons (2016).
